name: Folsom Europe 2026
description: The largest fetish event in Berlin, Folsom Europe is an offshoot of the famous San Francisco Folsom Street Fair. This four-day celebration of diverse fetishes—from leather to BDSM—includes the iconic Street Fair on Saturday, circuit parties at legendary clubs like SO36 (hosting Folsom Beardance) and Gretchen, official sightseeing and fetish bus tours, and events across Schöneberg and Kreuzberg. The festival represents a collision of global queer fetish culture with Berlin's underground club heritage, creating a politically charged space where sexual liberation meets community resistance and self-expression.
